served_reveal.what: Imagine AirCaps, live captions inside the lens.
served_reveal.how: You wear lightweight glasses with the app on them. The app shows live captions of what the people nearby are saying. The captions appear inside the lens.
served_reveal.belief: The people building it believe it would let you read the words while keeping eye contact.
served_reveal.bridge: The next questions are on the money side.
served_reveal.kicker: Part 1 of 1 · An idea to consider
served_reveal.problem: Deaf and hard-of-hearing adults lose the conversation when they sit around a table with hearing people, at a restaurant.
